name: VA Medical Center

decisions: Metro has 17 footprints here where OSM has one; compared against their union, OSM kept as one building (roof parts split it)
OSM and Metro differ (corner p95 12.64 m); OSM is as close or closer to the LiDAR edge (0.83 vs 0.87 m): OSM used
LiDAR roof edge lies a uniform 0.60 m outside the walls: logged as roof overhang, not corrected

44 edge(s) more than 0.3 m off the LiDAR edge moved to it: 1.55 m edge inward 1.19 m; 3.11 m edge inward 0.91 m; 15.38 m edge inward 1.14 m; 2.76 m edge inward 0.47 m; 3.04 m edge inward 1.19 m; 4.91 m edge inward 0.54 m ...

material_rule: walls and vertical roof steps brick_red (guess); roof faces flatter than 6 deg roof_flat, steeper roof_slate unless the Metro 2026 ortho color is clearly green (roof_copper) or orange-red (roof_tile); base concrete

collider.kind: one non-convex static triangle mesh (LoD2 shell without base cap)

accuracy.reason: footprint p95 0.437 m vs reference (43 corners moved to an irregular LiDAR edge); P2 (curved, 2972 m2): eave -0.34 m, ridge -0.03 m, 100% of roof points within 0.5 m; P5 (curved, 873 m2): eave -0.26 m, ridge +0.02 m, 100% of roof points within 0.5 m; P8 (curved, 448 m2): eave -0.55 m, ridge +0.00 m, 100% of roof points within 0.5 m; ... 18 more parts over 0.2 m

footprint.reference: osm outline; LiDAR edge for moved corners
